description: m1: the base64 of a frame with o.ps = 1 (a ps_type anomaly) followed by a newline; m2: the base64 of a valid frame with an unknown key (o.zz) with one space inside. A permissive decoder ignores the whitespace, the hashes match, and it would report FORCE_MSG_STRUCTURE (m1) and FORCE_UNKNOWN_KEY (m2). Under 2.2 both are UNDECODABLE: two RAW_HASH_MISMATCH, two MALFORMED messages (two voids), slot NONE, and NO FORCE finding (7.7a: there is no content to check).
title: whitespace inside or at the end of raw_b64
